title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
synopsis: 221B Baker Street. A cab in the rain. A client with a peculiar problem. You are, today, Holmes. The game, as he often says, is afoot.

nodes.text: She brings tea. Watson is at the window.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Read the paper” back. Practice shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
There is no taking “Wait for a knock” back. Patient shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: A young woman with a half-burned letter.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Read the letter.” The story records the instinct as “Path” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Method—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Outside, mud, two horses, fresh from the south road.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Pursue” back. Path shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Wait for more clues” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.

nodes.text: Scotland Yard's most enthusiastic mistake. He invites you to a scene.

choices.consequence: “Go” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Path.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Strategy—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: A locked study. Powder on the curtain. A faint scent of cigar.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Smell carefully” back. Method shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Look for fingerprints” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Modern.

nodes.text: The butler. The nephew. The maid. The dog who didn't bark.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Method—follows you into whatever comes next.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Obvious.

nodes.text: You become an unemployed groom. Watson is, briefly, scandalized.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Path—follows you into whatever comes next.
“Visit the gentleman's club” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Society.

nodes.text: Your brother knows things you don't. He weighs an opinion like a kingdom.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Visit the Diogenes Club” back. Wise shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: From the south coast. Inquire about the schooner Friesland.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Catch the next train.” The story records the instinct as “Path” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Telegraph back” back. Smart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: A figure in a top hat does not, in fact, want to be followed.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Cunning.

nodes.text: He talks. Money is, sometimes, fluent.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Pay him generously” back. Smart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Pay him modestly.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: You decode it in five minutes by counting letters.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Method.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Modesty—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: He is, in fact, the missing heir. He has been hiding for years.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Care.
You commit to “Confront.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: He is well-bred, well-dressed, and willing to murder. The worst kind.

choices.consequence: “Don't underestimate him” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.
“Take him alone” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Pride.

nodes.text: A different case, a different waterfall. He proposes single combat.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Brave.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Wise.

nodes.text: You and he go over. Watson finds the note.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Survive” back. Path shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Don't” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: You return to Baker Street disguised as a bookseller.

choices.consequence: “Reveal slowly” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Style.
There is no taking “Reveal quickly” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: She faints once and recovers twice.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Civil.
You commit to “Move past.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: He punches the table. He hugs you.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honor—follows you into whatever comes next.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Style.

nodes.text: A new client. A small problem. You smile.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Take the case.” The story records the instinct as “Path” and carries it forward.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Patient.

nodes.text: Mrs. Hudson brings tea. You and Watson sip in companionable silence.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Quiet.
You commit to “Begin the next thing.” The story records the instinct as “Path” and carries it forward.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You retire to Sussex to keep bees. You write a small book on apiology that is, mercifully, better than the police think.
Lestrade, decades on, gives a speech in your honor. He calls you, with feeling, the best and wisest man he ever knew. Watson cries discreetly.
Watson publishes. The Strand prints. The world reads. You are, against your will, a literary figure for two centuries.
